name: nexora
description: Nexora — Powerful Automation. Smarter Communities. Enterprise Discord bot platform.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @nexora/bot -w @nexora/api --if-present && npm run build -w @nexora/dashboard -w @nexora/admin --if-present
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @nexora/types && npm run build -w @nexora/config && npm run build -w @nexora/logger && npm run build -w @nexora/cache && npm run build -w @nexora/permissions && npm run build -w @nexora/validation && npm run build -w @nexora/discord && npm run build -w @nexora/ui && npm run build -w @nexora/database
